        events.append('index')
        decoder.buffer = b'index mutation'
        decoder.errors = 'strict'
        return -1

    events.append((error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason))
    decoder.buffer = b'callback mutation'
    assert input() == 'continue'
    if fail:
        raise failure
    return ('!', Position())
